item.title: Industrial IoT & SCADA Architecture: Transforming Energy Systems at Scale
item.author: info@pabbasian.com (Payman Abbasian)
item.description:
As a Technical Product Developer at E.ON, I specialize in modernizing energy infrastructure through advanced SCADA systems and Industrial IoT solutions. My work focuses on integrating distributed energy resources into Virtual Power Plants, enabling grid balancing and sustainable energy management at enterprise scale.

Core Expertise Areas:

  • Eclipse SCADA to Node-RED Migration: Leading the modernization of legacy industrial systems to improve scalability and maintainability
  • Virtual Power Plant (VPP) Development: Onboarding new asset types including battery systems and renewable energy sources
  • Kubernetes Automation: Streamlining deployment processes for industrial IoT applications
  • Industrial Protocol Integration: Working with Modbus, IEC104, and PLC systems for real-time data delivery

With nearly two decades of full-stack development experience, I bring deep technical expertise to complex energy challenges. My background spans enterprise software development, system architecture, and hands-on industrial automation implementation.
